literal: According to rule scepter wielding king in the country, rain and harvest having gathered [will be].
translation: In the land of a king who wields his scepter justly, rain and harvest will gather together.
modern: நீதியின்படி செங்கோல் செலுத்தி ஆட்சி செய்யும் மன்னவனது நாட்டில், மழையும் விளைச்சலும் ஒருசேரக் கூடியிருக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet connects the justice of a ruler with the natural prosperity of his land. The phrase 'இயல்புளி கோல் ஓச்சும்' describes a king who wields his scepter according to the proper nature of justice. In such a king's country, the natural elements respond favorably. Rain ('பெயல்') and agricultural yield ('விளையுள்') will gather together ('தொக்கு'), meaning they will be abundant and timely. The poem suggests that righteous governance brings about ecological and economic harmony.
